import re
import sys

values = {}
text = sys.stdin.read()

for name, source in re.findall(r'\b([A-Za-z]+)\s*<-\s*([A-Za-z]+|\d+)', text):
    values[name] = values[source] if source.isalpha() else int(source)

names = ("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "TMP")
print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in names) + ";")
